name: Anthony Henday LRT bridge, Heritage Valley
geometry_source: docs/edmonton-bridges/lrt-tracks.json, routes[12]: one OpenStreetMap construction way (railway, construction; 68 nodes, stored length 4677 m, retrieved 2026-10-14). The file has no OSM way id and no bridge tag on this section. Nodes are indexed from the south end at P178.
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal WGS84 length along the mapped nodes. It is not a structural length. The bracket below is not the deck: the deck ends are not published and not mapped. Node 26 is 4 m from the centre.

sections.which: Guideway around the Anthony Henday Drive crossing. Node 25 is 206 m south-west of the centre, node 26 is 4 m from it, node 27 is 321 m north-east of it. The deck ends lie somewhere inside this bracket; they are not published. The mapped track runs on a bearing of about 49 degrees (node 25 to 27, computed), which is the track direction, not the crossing skew.

elevations: No elevation is given. No deck, soffit, rail or ground height is published in any source checked, and none is computed here.
dropped_note: Dropped from T135. routes[12] also carries K204 (T135 to P178: nodes 0 to 26, about 2,152 m computed; lrt.md gives 2,155 m) and K203 (T135 to T134: nodes 26 to 41, about 751 m computed; lrt.md gives 752 m), plus the P177 and P145 sections north of T134. Those are K-code track sections in lrt.md, not T135, so their nodes are not carried into this file. The OpenStreetMap chord from node 19 to node 20 is 698 m with no intermediate node; it lies west of the crossing and outside the bracket. The Blackmud Creek bridge (T134, 53.4409, -113.5185) and the Heritage Valley North stop (P178) are different codes. The 87 Avenue and Valley Line West Henday bridge is a different structure and is not in this file. The stored way length of 4677 m does not match the computed 4671.3 m; the difference is in the file and does not affect the bracket.
known_gaps: Deck length, span lengths and arch positions are not published. The bracket is not a substitute for them.
